title: Final Round
core_verb: Strike the CPU fighter to empty its health bar within the round timer.
fantasy: A one-on-one arcade duel between two fighters on a flat strip.
fail_state: Your health reaches zero, or the round timer expires while your health is not higher than the opponent's.
win_state: The CPU fighter's health reaches zero before the round timer expires, or the timer expires with your health higher than the opponent's.

interaction_tags.meaning: CPU-generated strike hitbox; contact removes player health.
The goal target; emptying its health bar before time expires wins.

notes: The arcade ladder is reduced to a single round versus one CPU fighter on a flat strip, auto-facing the opponent. Special-move command motions are out of scope; only movement and basic strikes remain, and facing stays locked to the opponent.

assumptions: At timer expiry a health lead wins; a tie loses, consistent with fail_state.

scene.description: A flat stone fighting strip under a simple score roof, a crowd silhouette along the back, two fighters facing off. The strip is the whole arena. Sparse by design: nothing but the fighters and the ground.
